```{r}
library(tidyverse)
input <- readLines("advofcode2")
```

```{r}
input2 <- str_split(input, "x")
```

```{r}
papier <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(as.numeric(x))
  3 * (x[1] * x[2]) + 2 * (x[1] * x[3] + x[2] * x[3]) 
}
```

```{r}
input2 %>% 
  map(papier) %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  sum()
```

```{r}
ribbon <- function(x) {
  x <- sort(as.numeric(x))
  2 * sum(x[-3]) + prod(x)
}
```

```{r}
input2 %>% 
  map(ribbon) %>% 
  unlist() %>% 
  sum()
```
